name: User
rationale: User is the common principal type for subjects whose role memberships determine gradebook permissions.
plain_english_summary: A person using the gradebook system.
source_excerpt: No combination of roles exists such that a user with those roles can both Receive and Assign the resource ExternalGrades.

name: Student
rationale: Student is a role group used to express student-specific grade and enrollment permissions.
source_excerpt: Students receive external grades but must not assign external grades.

name: Faculty
rationale: Faculty is a role group used to express faculty grade assignment, viewing, and responsibility permissions.
plain_english_summary: The role group for faculty members.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can assign internal grades and external grades.

name: TeachingAssistant
rationale: TeachingAssistant is a role group used to express TA-specific internal-grade permissions and external-grade prohibitions.
plain_english_summary: The role group for teaching assistants.
source_excerpt: Teaching assistants can view and assign internal grades, but teaching assistants must not view or assign external grades.

name: FacultyFamily
rationale: FacultyFamily is a role group used to express external-grade receiving permissions for related faculty-family roles.
plain_english_summary: The role group for members of the faculty family.
source_excerpt: Members of the Faculty Family role can receive external grades.

name: Grade
rationale: Grade is the common parent resource type for grade actions that apply to grades generally.
plain_english_summary: A grade resource in the gradebook.
source_excerpt: If a subject is a faculty member, then permit that subject to assign grades.

name: InternalGrade
rationale: InternalGrade is a grade resource subtype needed because internal grades have different TA and faculty permissions from external grades.
plain_english_summary: A grade used internally in the course or gradebook process.
source_excerpt: Teaching assistants can view and assign internal grades, but teaching assistants must not view or assign external grades.

name: ExternalGrade
rationale: ExternalGrade is a grade resource subtype needed because external grades are received by students and faculty family but assigned only by faculty.
plain_english_summary: A grade that is external or final-facing rather than internal.
source_excerpt: Students receive external grades but must not assign external grades.

name: Course
rationale: Course is the resource type for enrollment requests.
plain_english_summary: A course that eligible users may enroll in.
source_excerpt: If a subject is not a faculty member, then permit that subject to enroll in courses.

name: assignGrade
rationale: assignGrade represents grade assignment requests across grade resources.
source_excerpt: If a subject is a faculty member, then permit that subject to assign grades.

name: assignInternalGrade
rationale: assignInternalGrade represents assignment requests specifically targeting internal grades.
source_excerpt: All members of Faculty can Assign both InternalGrades and ExternalGrades.

name: assignExternalGrade
rationale: assignExternalGrade represents assignment requests specifically targeting external grades.
source_excerpt: Students receive external grades but must not assign external grades.

name: viewInternalGrade
rationale: viewInternalGrade represents viewing requests specifically targeting internal grades.
source_excerpt: Teaching assistants can view and assign internal grades, but teaching assistants must not view or assign external grades.

name: viewExternalGrade
rationale: viewExternalGrade represents viewing requests specifically targeting external grades.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can view internal grades and external grades.

name: receiveExternalGrade
rationale: receiveExternalGrade represents requests where a principal receives an external grade resource.
source_excerpt: Members of the Faculty Family role can receive external grades.

name: takeFinalResponsibility
rationale: takeFinalResponsibility represents faculty responsibility over external grades.
plain_english_summary: Take final responsibility for an external grade.
source_excerpt: Faculty members take final responsibility for external grades.

name: enrollInCourse
source_excerpt: If a subject is not a faculty member, then permit that subject to enroll in courses.
